summary: Implements BIO-BIO-002 (guided tenprint/single-finger fingerprint enrolment), built directly on BIO-BIO-001's provider-neutral biometric contracts. EnrolmentMode.TenPrint/SingleFinger: FingerprintEnrolmentSession.Start fixes TargetPositions at session start - all ten standard finger positions for TenPrint, exactly one caller-chosen position for SingleFinger (AC01). FingerRecord records finger Position and a QualityScore from IFingerQualityScorer/SyntheticFingerQualityScorer on every capture (AC02). Recapture is calling CaptureFinger again for an already-captured position (CaptureCount increments, the record is superseded); MarkMissingOrAmputated is the distinct, terminal exception path, mutually exclusive with capture (AC03). FingerRecord.RetainedRawImage is populated only when the session's RetentionAuthorised flag (fixed at Start) is true - never by default after template derivation (AC04). Every mutating FingerprintEnrolmentService method (start/capture/mark-missing/complete/cancel) audits before committing, following the lock/audit-before-commit/ExistsAsync-verification/CancellationToken.None discipline established across BIO-TEN-001/BIO-TEN-002/BIO-DEV-001/BIO-IDN-001 (ADR-0003 Decision 7) (AC05). Feature-to-feature ProjectReference to BIO-BIO-001's Biolog.Features.Biometrics (same accepted shape as BIO-DOC-002/BIO-DOC-003 -> BIO-DOC-001, documented in this project's csproj remarks - NOT the bio-idn-family's different rule against referencing another feature's tenant-scoped aggregate). Repository and service are internal, gated by an explicit InternalsVisibleTo seam (BIO-IDN-001-QA-01 governance shape, closing the same class of defect that story's QA-01 finding required). Registered into the host via Modules/BioBio002Module.cs; no HTTP endpoints mapped (AC01-AC05 are about the session model, same deferred-integration judgment call as BioBio001Module).
notes: Verified: dotnet build api/Biolog.Api/Biolog.Api.csproj (full packaged host, all 20 registered modules including BioBio002Module) - 0 warnings/errors, ~25s with -m:1 /nodeReuse:false (required in this sandboxed environment - MSBuild node-reuse contention from concurrent agent builds on this floor; see BIO-BIO-001's builder evidence for the original diagnosis). dotnet test tests/features/bio-bio-002/Biolog.Features.FingerprintEnrolment.Tests.csproj - 30/30 passing (session domain invariants/CAS, service enrol/capture/recapture/exception/complete flows, AC02/AC04/AC05 behaviour, repository governance/tenant-isolation/cross-tenant-null reflection tests), run with the sandbox disabled for that one command only (vstest needs a loopback TCP socket for runner/host IPC that the default sandbox denies - SocketException 13, a confirmed environment restriction, not a code issue, same as BIO-BIO-001). tests/features/bio-bio-002/BIO-BIO-002.test.sh (offline structural checks) - 40/40 passing. python3 scripts/check-traceability.py --all - PASS (22 implemented stories). bash scripts/check-module-project-references.sh - PASS.
